# Settings

<!-- Generated by `node tests/settings-table/run.mjs` from the settings modules. Do not edit by hand. -->

The environment variables each process parses once at start-up, from the catalogue its settings
module keeps beside its parser, so a default is written in one place. Where a refused value
stops start-up, its meaning says so; the others leave their feature off, and the server log names
the variable. `.env.example` holds only deployment values
([ADR W1-INF-01](../adr/W1-INF-01-env-example-is-six-values.md)).

Covered: web, the model gateway, the runner manager and the egress proxy, the database,
master key and tracing settings they share (`packages/core`), and the `db:migrate` and `db:seed`
process entries. Most master key and runner manager
settings apply to one `MASTER_KEY_PROVIDER` or `RUNTIME_DRIVER`, named first in the meaning.

| Process | Variable | When unset | Meaning | Read by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| web | `AW_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` | unset: no proxy chain is trusted | How many reverse proxies in front of web append `X-Forwarded-For`, 1 to 16; `0` trusts none. Runnable public links refuse to run without it. Any other value stops start-up. | `apps/web/server/settings.ts` |
| web | `AW_CONTAINER_IDLE_STOP_SECONDS` | unset: not on Cloudflare | Seconds a Cloudflare Container idles before it stops; a run keeps 15 s of it for the interrupt. Whole seconds above that, or start-up stops. | `apps/web/server/settings.ts` |
| web | `SESSION_SECRET` | none: every /api/** request is refused | The key sign-in sessions are signed with, at least 32 characters. Changing it signs everyone out. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `AW_INSTANCE_ID` | unset: the default cookie names | Scopes the sign-in cookies to this deployment, so two deployments on one host do not sign each other out. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN` | none: password sign-in is refused | The email address of the first workspace owner, who signs in with a password. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | none: password sign-in is refused | That owner's password, at least 12 characters. Never stored. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `WORKSPACE_SLUG` | `default` | The workspace this deployment serves: lower-case letters, digits and `-`, up to 63. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `OIDC_ISSUER_URL` | unset: no single sign-on | The single sign-on provider. Set all four `OIDC_*` values together, or sign-in through it fails. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | unset | The client id this deployment has at the provider. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | unset | The client secret for that id. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `OIDC_REDIRECT_URI` | unset | This deployment's `/api/auth/callback` URL, as registered at the provider. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `AW_DEPLOYMENT_POSTURE` | `production` when `NODE_ENV` is `production`, otherwise `local` | Read here only for a plain-`http` loopback issuer: provider discovery may use `http` only under `local`. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `NODE_ENV` | unset | Decides the posture above when `AW_DEPLOYMENT_POSTURE` is unset. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| web | `HOST` | unset | The host web listens on; a `local` posture must listen on a loopback host. | `apps/web/server/auth-settings.ts` |
| shared | `DATABASE_URL` | none: web answers 503 on every /api/** route; the model gateway does not start | Web and the model gateway: the PostgreSQL connection string, `postgres://` or `postgresql://`, with a host or a `host=` socket. A value that does not parse, or a server that does not answer, is the same as unset. | `packages/core/src/settings.ts` |
| shared | `DATABASE_POOL_MAX` | 10 | Most connections each process's pool opens, 1 to 1000. Any other value has the same effect as an unusable `DATABASE_URL`. | `packages/core/src/settings.ts` |
